name: TC-CVP-02: Check Permit Info lead requests OTP successfully on CV Permit
fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/UsedTruck/CvPermit.cy.js#UsedTruck - CvPermit [en] — CV Permit TC-CVP-02: Check Permit Info lead requests OTP successfully on CV Permit
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-CVP-02
**Title:** Check Permit Info lead requests OTP successfully on CV Permit
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the CV Permit page, enter a sample vehicle registration number, click Check Permit Info to open its Get Information lead form (a distinct form from Check Offers), fill name, mobile and truck brand, and submit. This form is OTP-gated — there is no configured test OTP in this repo, so completion is verified up to the OTP screen, not full end-to-end submission.

**Expected Result:**
An OTP verification screen (with an Enter OTP field) appears, confirming the lead request succeeded. The submitted name is tagged with a page/CTA identifier for CRM traceability.

**Steps:**
1. Open the CV Permit page
2. Enter a sample vehicle registration number
3. Click Check Permit Info to open its lead form
4. Fill name, mobile and truck brand
5. Submit and verify the OTP screen appears
